image_description: A close-up view of a pipe organ console and the lower section of the pipe facade. The image features multiple wooden manuals (keyboards) with black and white keys, stop knobs arranged vertically on the side jambs, and a music rack holding sheet music. Behind the console, vertical metallic pipes of varying lengths are visible within a wooden casing.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Vertical metallic pipes are clearly visible in the background, arranged in groups behind wooden dividers.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is cropped at the top; while pipes vary in height, the full 'dramatic stepped silhouette' extending to the ceiling is not visible to verify the full range.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Rows of stop knobs are clearly visible on the right-side jamb of the console.

artifact_observations.location: Right side of the console (stop jambs)
artifact_observations.reasoning: The alignment of the stop knobs becomes slightly irregular and wavy towards the back, lacking the perfect linear precision expected in mechanical organ construction.

artifact_observations.location: Wood grain on the console side panels
artifact_observations.reasoning: The wood texture appears somewhat smudged and lacks fine detail, blending slightly into the shadows rather than showing crisp grain.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific classification of the instrument and distinguish it from other keyboard instruments like harpsichords.
To verify the spatial separation between the foreground console and the background pipes, ensuring no melting or depth collapse.
To check for fused keys or stop knobs, ensuring each functional component is a distinct physical object.
To analyze the legibility of the musical notation and detect any gibberish or rendering failures in the text/symbols.

focus_areas: Legibility of musical notation on the stand
Geometric regularity and alignment of stop knobs
Boundary sharpness between individual piano keys
Spatial depth between console and pipe facade
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the sheet music; AI often fails to render coherent musical notation. Check if the stop knobs are perfectly aligned or if they exhibit slight warping. Verify that the keys do not merge into each other at the edges.
